text:
jessica: FYI — we're seeing a small but noisy set of customer reports where onboarding calls result in duplicated downstream actions after a 429 during token refresh. not full outage, but painful. wondering if we should add a tiny telemetry/header to help server-side deduping + make SDK defaults safer.
noah: can you paste an example log? curious whether it's client replay or server reprocessing.
jessica: snippet from support dump (sanitized):
```\n2026-03-20T14:12:03Z client_id=acct-123 request_id=abc123 status=429 retry-after=0.5
2026-03-20T14:12:03Z client_id=acct-123 request_id=abc123 resent idempotency_key=none
2026-03-20T14:12:04Z server processed task order_create idempotency_key=none\n```
noah: ugh. two quick things: (1) SDKs should by-default attach an Idempotency-Key for mutating endpoints (or at least a config to enable that for sample apps). (2) add probabilistic sampling header for throttled requests so backend logs a tiny fraction with client state to diagnose.
jessica: +1. proposal for sampling header: `X-Rw-Throttle-Sample: 0.01` (server picks up the few and correlates with request_id). also propose a default safe-replay-window in SDKs = 30s and jittered exponential backoff tuned to Retry-After when present.
vikram: I like the sampling header. a few constraints: privacy (no PII), low cardinality, and sampling only when retry/backoff logic triggers. we should avoid sending full payloads.
noah: agree on privacy. suggested telemetry payload for sampled events (server only): `[client_version, sdk_language, sample_tag, short_error_code]` — all small and non-identifying. client sends header `X-Rw-Sample-Info: v=1;sdk=js;tag=throttle-retry` only on sampled requests.
jessica: example SDK pseudocode for safe defaults:
```js
// on mutating request
const idempotency = opts.idempotencyKey || generateUuid()
headers['Idempotency-Key'] = idempotency
if (shouldSampleThrottle()) headers['X-Rw-Throttle-Sample'] = '1' // server will decide
// backoff
await retryWithBackoff({initial:200, max:30000, jitter:true, useRetryAfter:true})
```
vikram: action items: 1) devex to propose SDK default: attach idempotency key on sample apps and document opt-out. 2) infra to accept and log `X-Rw-Throttle-Sample` and correlate with request_id. 3) SDKs add opt-in telemetry header `X-Rw-Sample-Info` only when sampling is enacted.
noah: +1 on opt-in. also add quick note: for streaming/generation endpoints we should avoid auto-idempotency by default — risky for long-running flows. document exceptions.
ci-bot: new issue created: #devex/832 add idempotency + throttle-sampling RFC (assignee: @vikram) :spiral_note_pad:
jessica: thanks — can someone from eng-runtime confirm server-side is ok to index `X-Rw-Throttle-Sample` before PII scrubbing? we only want a boolean/sample marker persisted for correlation.
vikram: i'll ping runtime. if infra can mark sampled traces and attach anonymized client metadata we'll be good. i'll own the RFC.
noah: once RFC is up can we add a tiny sample-app change to show opt-in telemetry and idempotency header (1 PR per SDK)? that will help onboard customers.
jessica: great. i'll drop a short checklist in the RFC for docs/devrel to mirror in onboarding guides. :thumbsup:
